exact_prompt:
Edit this ENTIRE exact game diffuse source UV canvas into a very modest HD hand-painted version. This reference is made ONLY by converting original stored RGB to opaque RGB and nearest-enlarging the WHOLE source canvas. Return precisely the same entire square canvas, normalized UV positions, painted field widths/heights, outlines, source faint marks, gaps and pattern scale. No crop, padding, frame, whitespace, zoom, fitting, rotation, rearrangement or newly visible parts. Final image uses original source alpha separately. Original black is source shadowpaint, not an invitation to interpret new hardware or holes.

Keep the original muted gray-violet painted palette. Preserve EXACTLY EIGHT existing nearblack5x5 fields in the native64x64 source: two upper-right [35,6,40,11] and [35,20,40,25], three upper-left [12,23,17,28], [22,23,27,28], [2,24,7,29], and three lower-right [35,54,40,59], [46,55,51,60], [57,55,62,60]. Keep precisely these counts/native positions and rectangular tiny footprints. Preserve the ONE original large rounded nearblack lower-left painted field native bbox[3,36,29,61], the irregular dark adjoining lower-left shadow, all original surrounding gray painted strips and their subdued shading. These black source fields must not gain bolts, rims, new geometric depth or glossy edges; preserve source paint rather than interpreting new physical hardware. Keep all faint outlines narrow and source-level.

Only gently resolve the existing subdued fine painted texture. Preserve all original weak local gray/brown strengths and broad shaded fields. No invented screws, rivets, fasteners, holes, outlines, relief, brighter edge, thicker bevel, extra strip, rust, woodgrain, weave, scratches, photographic grit, shine, lettering, symbol or decorative curl. Keep almost-flat regions almost-flat. Do not regularize irregular source shading or increase contrast. Do not make the faint dark marks glossy or raised. Output the ENTIRE opaque square texture with the exact source layout.

source_transform_recipe.operations: Native stored RGBA→opaqueRGB, wholecanvas NEAREST8x. No crop/padding/rotate/UV fitting/unpremultiply/art inserted. SourceA separately restored by root.
source_transform_recipe.inverse: ENTIRE raw LANCZOS to original4x; sourceA LANCZOS separately; scalar brightness and original native Type handling by root.

prompt_serialization: Exact actual built-in prompt UTF-8 argument including CRLF equals prompt file bytes; references portable identities resolved against current repo root.
